### Load environment

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| 
library(tidyverse)
```

#### Obtain list of file paths for datasets

```{r}
dataset_paths <- list.files(path = "../data/_raw/BEATAML1.0-COHORT/Transcriptome_Profiling/Gene_Expression_Quantification/",
                            recursive = TRUE,
                            full.names = TRUE)

head(dataset_paths)
```

#### Read all dataset files into a dataframe identified by file path

```{r}
df <- read_tsv(file = dataset_paths,
               comment = "#",
               id = "file",
               show_col_types = FALSE)

head(df)
```

#### Convert to count matrix with samples as columns

```{r}
count_matrix <- df |> 
  select(file, gene_id, unstranded) |> 
  filter(str_starts(gene_id, "ENS")) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = file,
              values_from = unstranded) |> 
  rename_with(.cols = starts_with("../data/"),
              .fn = ~ str_split_i(string = .x,
                                  pattern = "/",
                                  i = -2))
head(count_matrix)
```
